NAIROBI COUNTY SERVICES

Register as a citizen

Your first mission is to visit the Nairobi Government Offices and register for your citizen ID.

  • Bring your character's identification details.
  • Follow the directions on your mini-map to find the government offices.
  • Speak to the registration officer when you arrive.
